item.title: A meal photo you text Murph is logged once
item.summary: When the iPhone app's automatic meal capture finds a photo you already texted Murph, it now joins the meal Murph saved instead of adding a second one.
item.details: Only the same photo is matched, so a second shot of your plate or a different dish is still logged on its own. Photos you send from the app's own meal sheet work as before.
